_note: Which people built each settlement, which sets its street plan (tools/towns.mjs). Races: human = medieval sprawl with a French radial plan; atma = Roman grid (Atman humans); egyptian = Nile city (the human nation of north-eastern Curmeah); elf = nature-woven, art nouveau curves in golden ratios; dwarf = carved into the Stone, symmetrical art deco fans and steps; orc = functional brutalist slabs; goblin = random and haphazard; viking = Argusund humans (ring fort, longhouses, boat sheds); gnome = halfling-style burrows (Boddendell); minotaur = a labyrinth city (Phocacia). Order of precedence: byName, then the longest matching byRealm entry (matched against the settlement's trail in the notes, e.g. 'Geas > Citadel'), then bySource (the map it came from), then default. Edit, then run towns.mjs.
_ruins: Ruined settlements that get a plan too (name: size, 1 village, 2 town, 3 city). Drawn broken: most houses gone, walls in pieces.
_ruinSites: Ruins with no pin of their own: a plan is made at this world-px point (name, size) and labelled on the map.
